title: The identity matrix
prompt:
Implement four static predicates — each must use `==` (identity), not equals:
1. `static boolean pooledLiterals()` — is `"jvm" == "jvm"` (two literals)?
2. `static boolean newStringSameAsLiteral()` — is `new String("jvm") == "jvm"`?
3. `static boolean internedMatches()` — is `new String("jvm").intern() == "jvm"`?
4. `static boolean boxCacheHolds()` — is `Integer.valueOf(127) == Integer.valueOf(127)`?
5. `static boolean boxCacheMisses()` — is `Integer.valueOf(128) == Integer.valueOf(128)`?
6. `static boolean bigBoxSame()` — is `Integer.valueOf(1000) == Integer.valueOf(1000)`?
Return the *actual* results, whatever they are — the tests know the truth.

tests.name: constant pool and cache truth
tests.hint: Pool deduplicates literals; new always allocates; intern canonicalizes.

tests.name: boxing cache boundaries
